page_title: CUR 0-2 IVO | Curacao v Ivory Coast 25/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+4' Jean Seri (Ivory Coast) will take a corner kick.
90+4' Elye Wahi (Ivory Coast) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Ivory Coast are awarded a corner kick.

90+3' Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Sherel Floranus (Curacao) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

90+2' A rebound falls at the feet of Gervane Kastaneer (Curacao) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ivory Coast.
90+2' Brandley Kuwas (Curacao) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
90+1' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90+1' Tyrese Noslin (Curacao) picks up a pass, lines up a shot and strikes from 35 metres out, but Yahia Fofana thwarts the effort which is headed to the roof of the net. Curacao have a corner.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dick Advocaat prepares a substitution. Jurgen Locadia is replaced by Brandley Kuwas (Curacao).
90' It's time for a substitution. Shurandy Sambo (Curacao) comes on in place of Joshua Brenet.
90' The attendance for today's match is 68324.
89' Elye Wahi (Ivory Coast) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Eloy Room makes a great save to stop his effort.
88' One of the Ivory Coast players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
87' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jean Seri (Ivory Coast) is cleared to safety by the defence.
86' Bazoumana Toure (Ivory Coast) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Ivory Coast get a corner.
85' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Curacao, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
83' Gervane Kastaneer (Curacao) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
83' Christ Inao Oulai (Ivory Coast) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Curacao are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
81' Elye Wahi (Ivory Coast) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
80' Ivory Coast quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
80' Oumar Diakite (Ivory Coast) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Ivory Coast will have a corner.

79' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ivory Coast.
77' Emerse Fae decides to make a substitution. Franck Kessie will be replaced by Jean Seri (Ivory Coast).
77' Dick Advocaat has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gervane Kastaneer (Curacao) replacing Jurien Gaari.
77' Deveron Fonville will be replaced by Tyrese Noslin (Curacao).
76' Deveron Fonville (Curacao) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
75' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
74' Some great play by Tahith Chong (Curacao) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Yahia Fofana sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
73' Joshua Brenet (Curacao) is flagged for offside.
72' Curacao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
68' A cooling break is underway.
67' That will be all from Yan Diomande who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bazoumana Toure (Ivory Coast).
67' Here is a change. Ange-Yoan Bonny is going off and Emerse Fae gives the last tactical orders to Oumar Diakite (Ivory Coast).
67' Here's the change. Nicolas Pepe leaves the pitch and Elye Wahi (Ivory Coast) comes on as a substitute.
66' The ball is cleared after Tahith Chong (Curacao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' 0 - 2 It's 0:2! Ibrahim Sangare feeds Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top left corner.
62' Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
61' Dick Advocaat has decided to substitute Livano Comenencia and he is replaced by Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao).
59' Yan Diomande (Ivory Coast) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
58' Glenn Nyberg has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jurien Gaari (Curacao).
55' Sherel Floranus (Curacao) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Ivory Coast will have a goal kick.
53' The corner from Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) is hurriedly cleared.

53' Franck Kessie (Ivory Coast) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Ivory Coast have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

52' The most active player in today's match is definitely Yan Diomande (Ivory Coast). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
51' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Christ Inao Oulai (Ivory Coast) but poses no threat.
49' Jurgen Locadia (Curacao) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
48' Tahith Chong (Curacao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Ivory Coast in a dangerous position.
47' Flag up against Christ Inao Oulai (Ivory Coast). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' Half-time substitution. Emerse Fae decided to make a change. Amad Diallo is replaced by Christ Inao Oulai (Ivory Coast).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

45+4' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Curacao have been awarded a corner kick.

45+3' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball is out of play. Curacao win a corner kick.
45+2' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
45+2' Ibrahim Sangare (Ivory Coast) brings an opponent down and Glenn Nyberg interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Curacao.
45+1' Franck Kessie (Ivory Coast) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

44' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ivory Coast.
43' Franck Kessie (Ivory Coast) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Yan Diomande (Ivory Coast) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
42' Christopher Operi (Ivory Coast) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Ivory Coast have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Neat passing move from Ivory Coast in order to create new attacking opportunities. 26:74 – the latest ball possession ratio.
40' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Tahith Chong (Curacao) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ivory Coast.
38' Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) and Nicolas Pepe attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
37' Guela Doue (Ivory Coast) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
36' Sherel Floranus (Curacao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Ivory Coast.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) was quite harsh and Glenn Nyberg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

33' Deveron Fonville (Curacao) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Glenn Nyberg blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Ivory Coast have a free kick.
32' The foul by Livano Comenencia (Curacao) was seen by Glenn Nyberg who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
31' Sherel Floranus (Curacao) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
30' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

30' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Curacao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Ivory Coast work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
27' Christopher Operi (Ivory Coast) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
24' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' Jurien Gaari (Curacao) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
23' Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.

22' Yan Diomande (Ivory Coast) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Christopher Operi (Ivory Coast) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
21' Glenn Nyberg blows his whistle for a foul after Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) hacks down one of his opponents. Free kick. Ivory Coast will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' Deveron Fonville (Curacao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' A short pass from Yan Diomande puts Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails well wide of the right post.
18' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:2. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
17' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ange-Yoan Bonny (Ivory Coast), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
16' Yan Diomande (Ivory Coast) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

14' Jurien Gaari (Curacao) received a killer pass and sent a long-range missile shot. To his misfortune, it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ivory Coast will have a goal kick.
12' Glenn Nyberg interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jurien Gaari (Curacao). There is a free kick near the sideline to Ivory Coast.
11' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

10' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Amad Diallo (Ivory Coast), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Curacao.
9' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Ivory Coast will take a free kick.

7' 0 - 1 Goal! Yan Diomande displays great vision and sends a pass to Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
6' Glenn Nyberg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Armando Obispo (Curacao) and blew his whistle. Ivory Coast win a free kick.
6' Ivory Coast keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

4' Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
2' Tahith Chong (Curacao) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Yahia Fofana.
2' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Ivory Coast) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
